messages:
alex: Heads-up — Vendor asked if we can align an H100/H200 + MI300 + Gaudi joint announcement. They want a single press window but have staggered SKU certs. Can partnerships + product weigh in on embargo optics and marketplace SKU availability?
announce-bot: Posted vendor brief: https://vendor.example.com/release-brief — notes on SKU readiness and gating.
priyam: I can take the compatibility matrix. Do we have a list of forced-fallback model variants for each SKU?
tina: We do for H100/H200. B200 fallback is the tricky one — quantized variant only lands next week. :grimacing:
jack: From infra side, dedicated capacity can be ready but need final image tags from vendor-eng. Any ETA?
vendor-eng: image tags by EOD Friday, but Gaudi drivers still on a late QA loop. MI300 microcode cleared yesterday.
maria: Press strategy ask — can we promise marketplace SKU availability on announce day, or do we need a phased messaging plan?
priyam: If Gaudi is flaky, we should plan phased: H100/H200 + MI300 in wave 1, Gaudi in wave 2 with clear "coming soon" messaging.
alex: That sounds sensible. Partnerships would prefer single coordinated window, but phased public messaging is OK if internal embargo handshake is crisp.
tina: Operational ask: if we do phased, set marketplace tags: wave1: ga=ready,hw=H100,H200,MI300 ; wave2: ga=soon,hw=Gaudi. I can draft a tag map.
jack: Also add a fallback routing policy for customers who request Gaudi but we don't have capacity — route to MI300 variant automatically. We should script the policy now.
vendor-eng: Noted. We'll include fallback model metadata in the image manifest. Example snippet we can add to manifest:
```
fallbacks:
  gaudi: [mi300-quant, h200-quant]
  h200: [h100-quant]
```
maria: Nice. For external comms, let's avoid exact SKU ship dates; use "available in limited regions" + follow-up blog for full SKU timeline. Keeps flexibility.
priyam: Also need a short eval set for regression checks on quantized variants before announce. 100 prompts per workload should be enough for smoke.
jack: I'll spin up canary pool and run eval. ETA 48h after image tags.
alex: Action items: tina draft tag map + messaging copy; priyam build eval set; jack run canary + routing policy; vendor-eng supply image tags and fallback manifest by Friday. We'll reconvene Monday if anything slips. :thumbsup:
tina: Copy that. I'll post the draft in /docs and ping legal for embargo wording.
vendor-eng: Will do, flagging risk: Gaudi driver QA could slip 72h; will update if it moves.
maria: If it slips, we switch to phased external messaging. Good to have contingency.
alex: Thanks team. If anyone hears from vendor PM directly, drop a quick note here. :)
